note: Passing repro cases assert the observed defect; they are not acceptance tests.

findings.title: Existing-plan Add profiles invokes subscription creation checkout
findings.observed: Active plan with hasSubscription=true enables Add profiles. Submission calls settings.billing.checkout with absolute quantity. Pinned backend always creates a Stripe Checkout Session in subscription mode; it does not read or update an existing subscription. ensureCustomer only reuses the customer. Existing subscription quantity management is documented on the portal path.
findings.reproduction: Using settingsFixtures active subscription, open Billing and Add profiles. Review checkout remains enabled. Do not submit. Read pinned backend service lines95-145 and148-166.
findings.deploymentImpact: Block existing-payer Add profiles path pending reviewed semantics. Source mismatch is proven; duplicate subscriptions/charges were not executed or claimed.

findings.title: Modules Calendar loses a verified client selection on entry
findings.observed: After shared ApplicationBoundary verifies the client in the URL, Calendar initializes clientId to empty, displays Master view and sends engagement.meetings without clientId. Global /calendar retains the same hint correctly.
findings.reproduction: Supply verified client response and clients.list, visit scoped Modules calendar; inspect selected scope and request.
findings.deploymentImpact: Wrong client scope is displayed and queried within permitted records; no authorization bypass claimed.

findings.title: Modules Agenda drops the start of tasks with a separate due date
findings.observed: plannerItems chooses task.dueOn ?? task.startOn and creates one task key. A task scheduled October10 and due October12 appears only October12. Global /calendar preserves both distinct occurrences.
findings.reproduction: Return task with startOn2026-10-10 and dueOn2026-10-12, select Agenda in October. Only the due row is rendered.
findings.deploymentImpact: Users miss scheduled starts; route-specific defect, not a failed canonical global-calendar occurrence check.

findings.title: Modules meetings failure hides independently loaded agenda sources
findings.observed: All agenda content is inside StatusPanel driven by meetings. A403 meeting response hides a successful Planner feed although its source chip says1. Global /calendar keeps the Planner rows visible with a meeting error.
findings.reproduction: Return403 for engagement.meetings, successful planner.tasks, select Agenda. Planner1 is visible but no table or task row exists.
findings.deploymentImpact: One unavailable source suppresses useful independently authorized sources.

findings.title: Modules agenda task links never open the referenced task
findings.observed: Agenda links include task=id, but PlannerScreen and TaskWorkspace do not read that parameter. The destination is default My tasks with no selected task dialog. Generic Planner list/edit/complete works when a task is selected from its own list.
findings.reproduction: Click the synthetic task title in Modules Agenda. URL has task=id, Planner heading appears, dialog count remains0.
findings.deploymentImpact: Calendar-to-task drilldown stops short of the requested record; do not label the canonical Planner task writer unavailable.

findings.title: Modules meeting detail omits supplied join link and designed split view
findings.observed: Reviewed response schema retains joinLink but shared MeetingDetail never renders it. Fixture with https://example.test/join yields no link in the dialog. The meetings surface is a table plus modal, unlike Figma list/detail split view with Join, attendee line and prep panel. No claim that missing Meri execution controls can work without backend integration.
findings.reproduction: Open populated Engagement Meetings and click record. Inspect dialog and supplied joinLink.
findings.deploymentImpact: Users cannot join from the Modules meeting detail even when the source supplies a link; substantial remaining Figma mismatch. Portfolio global MeetingDetail separately renders Join and attendees.

findings.title: Workspace desktop filters expand to three full-width rows
findings.observed: Workspace CSS targets .filters > select. SelectInput renders a Radix button with width100%, so client/template/status triggers each take a whole row. At1440 the document table begins around y749 instead of the designed y584 compact layout.
findings.reproduction: Visit Workspace at1440x1040 with reviewed empty library fixture. The three dropdowns span the full content width.
findings.deploymentImpact: Pushes library content below the intended fold; backend data does not resolve this CSS mismatch.

findings.title: Planner All tasks lacks the authored client grouping and scope controls
findings.observed: Figma groups All tasks under client headings with Open client links and Group by Client plus scope selector. Source renders one flat task table with estimate/actual columns and has no Group by control or page-level client selector. Available task clientId and project membership filtering are already represented in source.
findings.reproduction: Open All tasks with a permitted populated task list; compare controls and table structure with411:95475.
findings.deploymentImpact: Firm-wide task presentation is not Figma accepted; generic task operations remain implemented.

findings.title: Public Planner form loses the designed title and validation hierarchy
findings.observed: Figma places eyebrow and a40px title within the card over a muted canvas, with bounded submit and styled error strip. Source puts eyebrow outside the card, uses shared Panel small heading, white canvas, full-width submit and unstyled error after submit. Error retains input and successful fixture submission shows the receipt.
findings.reproduction: Render Request a briefing with text/select/attachment questions; submit against a synthetic400 error, then successful received:true fixture.
findings.deploymentImpact: Visual acceptance remains open; the checked receipt/error behavior passes synthetic scope.

dependenciesAndUnavailable.scope: All14 Global Master calendar rows and Modules/Settings
dependenciesAndUnavailable.detail: No native Clerk session, role/RLS matrix, exact deployed API release, real calendar provider, microphone/socket/S3, billing, mail delivery or durable strategy execution was qualified. All14 row full acceptances remain OPEN_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.

Canonical /calendar calls only Federal Register upcoming-deadlines (max50/next30days); no SAM/SBIR funding feed appears in its queries.ts. Modules Calendar has a separate intelligence.funding.search adapter, which is not proof of global coverage. Full range and funding composition still need owner integration/acceptance.
Publisher effective civil dates are implemented with provenance/partial-coverage warnings. Markup/floor-vote forecasts remain unavailable without published source/confidence/time semantics.

dependenciesAndUnavailable.scope: Settings Memory/Meri Preferences, Engagement aggregate plans, HQ impersonation/SAM/provisioning, Meri assistant controls
dependenciesAndUnavailable.detail: Documented missing reviewed contracts are explicitly unavailable, not confirmed frontend failures. Do not substitute legacy runtime or invent aggregate/private access.
Hosted billing portal is implemented; authored in-app cancellation-window/survey/term semantics lack equivalent reviewed API. Distinct from confirmed MS01 checkout mismatch.
